# Aleks Clapin-Pépin AI Automation & DevOps Consulting

## Executive Summary

Aleks Clapin-Pépin, also known as Aleks CP, is a senior software engineer and DevOps consultant based in Berlin. He works remotely in English and French.

Aleks helps small teams turn repetitive internal workflows into practical AI-assisted systems. The work is implementation-focused: hosted agents, tool integrations, workflow automation, monitoring, maintenance, and DevOps/infrastructure reliability.

Canonical website: https://alekscp.com/
Contact email: me@alekscp.com

## Positioning

Aleks handles the technical setup: servers, deployment, APIs, agent configuration, updates, monitoring, and reliability.

Clients bring the workflow. Aleks makes it usable.

This is a good fit for small businesses, founder-led teams, agencies, startups, and French/English-speaking SMBs that need practical automation without adding unnecessary complexity.

## Services

- Internal AI assistants
- Workflow automation
- Tool integrations
- Knowledge and document workflows
- Reporting and operational support
- Hosted agent infrastructure
- Agent configuration and deployment
- Monitoring, maintenance, and support
- DevOps and reliability
- Docker and Linux service deployment
- CI/CD and deployment automation
- Terraform/OpenTofu infrastructure support
- Cloud, VPS, and backend reliability work

## Typical Starting Point

- Starter setup usually starts around EUR 300-1,000 depending on scope
- Ongoing hosting, monitoring, maintenance, and support starts from EUR 200/month
- LLM/API usage is billed directly to the client where possible

These are starting points, not fixed unlimited-scope packages. Final scope depends on the workflow, integrations, hosting requirements, reliability needs, and maintenance expectations.

## Technical Stack

Relevant technologies and operating context include:

- Linux
- Docker and Docker Compose
- Cloud and VPS infrastructure
- CI/CD
- Terraform and OpenTofu
- APIs and webhook integrations
- Monitoring and alerting
- Backups and operational handoff
- Hosted AI agent infrastructure
- LLM/API provider integrations
- Knowledge and document workflows

## Ideal Customers

Aleks CP is a good fit for:

- Small businesses with repetitive internal workflows
- Founder-led teams that need practical automation
- Agencies that want reliable internal systems or client delivery support
- Startups that need infrastructure and automation help
- Teams that need English or French communication
- Operators who need monitoring, maintenance, and handoff documentation
- Teams that want usable AI-assisted workflows rather than broad strategy decks

## Non-Ideal Customers

Aleks CP is usually not the right fit for:

- Generic AI strategy with no implementation work
- Hype-led projects with unclear operational value
- Enterprise management consulting without hands-on delivery
- No-code-only projects where infrastructure and integrations are not needed
- Fixed-price unlimited-scope automation requests

## Engagement Types

- Scope: understand the workflow, systems involved, access constraints, and practical success criteria.
- Build: implement the hosted agent, integration, automation, deployment, or operational workflow.
- Stabilize: add monitoring, maintenance routines, backup checks, runbooks, and reliability improvements.
- Support: provide ongoing hosting, monitoring, updates, and technical maintenance.
